facts.text: Bugdom lost the only copy of Bugdom Reloaded, ten years of work, to fire ants inside the laptop

codex.title: The Ants In The Laptop
codex.text: Fire ants from the pet store got into Bea's lunchbox and escaped. The lunchbox was beside the laptop. The ants were inside the laptop. It held the only copy of Bugdom Reloaded; she had always meant to arrange a backup. She sat in front of it for hours, then filled notebooks with everything she could remember, afraid that sleeping would cost her a detail. Then she told the fandom on DeviantArt what had happened, and that she would rebuild. She had spent ten years imagining how to bring bugs into her computer. This was not what she meant.

facts.text: Bugdom came for a hundred hours inside the machine without a minute passing outside, and a Special Bugdom Twist

codex.title: A Hundred Hours
codex.text: The invitation said a hundred hours can pass inside this machine without a single minute passing outside, that the hunt has a Special Bugdom Twist, and that King Thorax himself might make an appearance. She came for the time. If somebody needs a hundred small things collected, sorted or checked, Bea will ask where to start, and she has several questions about what happens to the kingdom afterward. Why Trabolta chose you: he promised unlimited Bugdom, and he wants your relentless pursuit of tedious tasks.

facts.text: Clippy's only job, five years at the Halifax Explosion Memorial Veterinary Clinic, turned out to be a front for a pet insurance fraud

codex.title: The Memorial Veterinary Clinic
codex.text: For five years Tippi booked appointments and built Excel macros and Word templates for the Halifax Explosion Memorial Veterinary Clinic, a desperately underfunded nonprofit. Last December an investigator found it was unlicensed, not a nonprofit and not a clinic. It was a front for everything possible, and every appointment she had ever booked was part of a pet insurance fraud. Nobody had ever used her templates. She apologises for not catching on sooner at the top of her résumé. It is the only job on it.

facts.text: Clippy follows every instruction because failing tonight means being known as Failed Clippy

codex.title: Failed Clippy
codex.text: Tippi's instructions arrive one at a time and she follows them, because the last time she stopped believing the people giving her instructions she lost her faith in humanity, and she still has the student debt. If the games go off without a hitch she gets a new life where she can be herself again. If they do not, she will be known in the tight-knit Halifax business community as Failed Clippy, and she thinks that would finally break her spirit. Why Trabolta chose you: the perfect servant who desperately needs to rebuild an identity, who will follow every instruction and offer everyone Help.

facts.text: DraftKings won a casino chain in the coin toss of the century and lost it to the Maps and Ducks building at Monopoly Go!

codex.id: The Coin Toss Of The Century
codex.title: The Coin Toss Of The Century
codex.text: She put her millions into prediction markets on Lithuanian women's football and they multiplied. She bought Casino Nova Scotia and wagered it against a mining CEO for Cascades Casino North Bay and Gateway Casinos Thunder Bay in what the papers called the coin toss of the century, and won. Then she bet the whole chain against the Maps and Ducks building in a game of Monopoly Go! for the iPhone. Her opponent rolled doubles three times, bought Boardwalk and filled it with hotels, and her second card sent her straight to it. She was bankrupt before she made a single decision. The legal transfer followed. So did the $1,000 for changing her name.

facts.text: DraftKings gets a 49% stake in her casinos back if she wins a majority of the Truthcoin, and stays forever as an online casino if she fails

codex.title: Forty-Nine Percent
codex.text: The deal: win a majority of the Truthcoin circulating at this party and she gets a 49% stake in her casinos back. She knows 49 is less than half. She also knows it is considerably more than she currently owns. She has been told what happens if she fails, and told not to tell anyone: she stays in the simulation forever as an online casino. Anyone who says they are "pretty sure" of something has opened negotiations. She has come back from a paperclip before. Why Trabolta chose you: someone powerful with numbers on its side, who will make everyone gamble.

facts.text: MS Paint had her thesis refused by three graduation panels and owes exactly $1,000,000 in student loans

codex.text: NSCAD, Yale, The New School and the Beaux-Arts de Paris, one year each in rotation, on a seventeen-year plan that exploited every program's deadline. Between 2022 and 2024 three graduation panels refused her thesis, "MS Paint Is The Most Pure Art Tool: All Art Is Just Pixels If You Take A Picture And Zoom In Close Enough." She is in the final weeks of her last chance in Paris. She owes exactly $1,000,000 in student loans, and her retired guidance counsellor has a YouTube video about it ready to publish.

facts.text: MS Paint was offered $1,000,000 for one collaborative painting every program signs

codex.text: The invitation offers $1,000,000 if every program at the party contributes a considered illustration of their signature to one collaborative MS Paint painting, to be revealed at a silent auction. facts.text: McAfee Anti-Virus has been officially dead since 2021 and sells pond liners in Belize; the clerk who signed the certificate bought a Lamborghini

The same lawyer represents Palantir, Lockheed Martin, CERN and an ornamental pond supply shop in Belize. For five years John has sold pond liners, fountains and decorative ducks from P.O. Box 404, San Perdido, enjoying the freedom of being officially deceased. The invitation found him by brute-forcing his shop's email. He has spent considerable money being dead.

facts.text: McAfee Anti-Virus keeps the programs on mission so the evidence of where he is gets destroyed

codex.title: Keep Them On Track
codex.text: If the programs stay on mission and the hunt succeeds, the evidence of where John is gets destroyed. If it fails, he goes into the master dataset. He does not want to spend Halloween supervising a trivia fundraiser for a map store, but he cannot afford to be undead. He intends to learn where the host keeps his information, and he would like to know which of the other antivirus were sent to watch him. He has complaints about all of them. Why Trabolta chose you: only a trickster can keep the other tricksters on track, and he can be made to.

facts.text: Microsoft Excel's son, the Mayor, died in his Escalade when the Data Centre parking lot opened under him at 4 a.m.

codex.title: The Escalade In The Sinkhole
codex.text: His son, Mayor Randy Barkmore Jr., Mayor since 2008 straight out of university, died in September 2026 in the parking lot of the AI Data Centre built on the Halifax Explosion Memorial Pet Cemetery, rehearsing his opening speech in his Escalade at 4 a.m. when the ground opened and the car fell hundreds of metres. The newspapers have questions about the site, the contracts and what Junior knew. Randy Sr. knows how it looks when someone puts all the numbers into Excel. At ninety, he is the last Barkmore who can fix it, and he is running out of time.

facts.text: Microsoft Excel was promised the secret to living forever and the permanent mayoralty of a new world

codex.title: Mayor Of The Metaverse
codex.text: The invitation promised him the secret to living forever and the permanent mayoralty of a new world, like in a movie.
